AcceptInquiredSystemEvent.title: Accept and authorize a system event operation
AcceptInquiredSystemEvent.summary: Accepts and authorizes the execution of a system event operation. For a system event in the Inquiring state, this operation accepts the default action of the system event and authorizes the system to execute the default action.

AddTags.title: Add or overwrite tags on ECS resources
AddTags.summary: Adds or overwrites one or more tags on Elastic Compute Service (ECS) resources. You can add tags to instances, cloud disks, snapshots, images, security groups, and other resources for easier management.

AllocateDedicatedHosts.title: Create one or more pay-as-you-go or subscription dedicated hosts
AllocateDedicatedHosts.summary: Creates one or more pay-as-you-go or subscription dedicated hosts. A dedicated host is a physical server exclusively used by a single tenant. You can create ECS instances on a dedicated host and view the attributes of the physical server.

AllocatePublicIpAddress.title: Assign a public IP address
AllocatePublicIpAddress.summary: Assigns a public IP address to an ECS instance. We recommend that you call the ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec operation to assign a public IP address.

ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: Apply automatic snapshot policy to cloud disks
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Applies an automatic snapshot policy to one or more cloud disks.

AssignIpv6Addresses.title: Assign IPv6 addresses to an ENI
AssignIpv6Addresses.summary: Assigns one or more IPv6 addresses to an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

AssignPrivateIpAddresses.title: Assign secondary private IP addresses to an ENI
AssignPrivateIpAddresses.summary: Allocates one or more secondary private IP addresses to an Elastic Network Interface (ENI). You can specify idle private IP addresses within the vSwitch to which the ENI belongs, or specify the number of private endpoint addresses to automatically allocate private IP addresses.

AssociateHaVip.title: AssociateHaVip
AssociateHaVip.summary: Associates a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip) with an ECS instance or an elastic network interface (ENI).

AttachClassicLinkVpc.title: Connect a classic network-type instance to a VPC
AttachClassicLinkVpc.summary: Invokes AttachClassicLinkVpc to connect a classic network type instance to a virtual private cloud (VPC) so that the instance can communicate with cloud resources in the VPC through private network peering.

AttachDisk.title: Attach a disk to an instance
AttachDisk.summary: Attaches a data disk or system disk to an ECS instance.

AttachInstanceRamRole.title: Attach an instance RAM role to instances
AttachInstanceRamRole.summary: Attaches an instance RAM role to one or more ECS instances.

AttachKeyPair.title: Attach an SSH key pair to linux instances
AttachKeyPair.summary: Attaches an SSH key pair to one or more Linux instances.

AttachNetworkInterface.title: Attach an ENI to a VPC-type instance
AttachNetworkInterface.summary: Attaches an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) to a VPC-type ECS instance by calling the AttachNetworkInterface operation with parameters such as NetworkInterfaceId, InstanceId, and NetworkCardIndex.

AuthorizeSecurityGroup.title: Add inbound security group rules
AuthorizeSecurityGroup.summary: Adds one or more inbound rules to a security group. You can use this operation to specify inbound access permissions for a security group, allowing or denying other devices from sending inbound traffic to instances in the security group, which enables fine-grained network access control.

AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress.title: Add outbound security group rules
AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress.summary: Adds one or more outbound rules to a security group. This operation allows you to specify outbound access permissions for a security group to allow or deny instances in the security group from sending outbound traffic to other devices, enabling fine-grained control over network access.

CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: Cancel the automatic snapshot policy for cloud disks
CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Cancels the automatic snapshot policy for one or more cloud disks.

CancelCopyImage.title: Cancel an ongoing image copy task

CancelPhysicalConnection.title: CancelPhysicalConnection
CancelPhysicalConnection.summary: Cancels an application for an Express Connect circuit. You can cancel an Express Connect circuit only when it is in the `Initial` or `Approved` state.

CancelSimulatedSystemEvents.title: Cancel simulated system events
CancelSimulatedSystemEvents.summary: Cancels one or more simulated system events that are in the Scheduled or Executing state. After a system event is canceled, the simulated event enters the Canceled state.

CancelTask.title: Cancel a task
CancelTask.summary: Cancels a running task. You can cancel running image import tasks (ImportImage) and image export tasks (ExportImage).

CloneDisks.title: Disk cloning
CloneDisks.summary: Disk cloning allows you to quickly replicate a disk with the same data as the source disk in the same zone. The cloned disk supports custom capacity, type, and encryption attributes. After the cloned disk is attached to an instance, you can quickly replicate business data or horizontally scale services.

ConvertNatPublicIpToEip.title: Convert a public IP address to an elastic IP address
ConvertNatPublicIpToEip.summary: Converts the public IP address (PublicIP) of a VPC-type ECS instance to an Elastic IP Address (EIP).

CopyImage.title: Copy a custom image to another region
CopyImage.summary: Copies a custom image from one region to another. You can use this operation to deploy ECS instances across regions or replicate ECS instances across regions.

CopySnapshot.title: Copy a snapshot
CopySnapshot.summary: Copies a standard snapshot or encrypted snapshot from one region to another.

CreateActivation.title: Creates an activation code.
CreateActivation.summary: Creates an activation code that is used to register non-Alibaba Cloud servers as Alibaba Cloud managed instances.

CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: Create an automatic snapshot policy
CreateAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Creates an automatic snapshot policy in a specified region. You can specify the repeat cycle, retention period, and cross-region backup settings for automatic snapshots to back up data on system disks or data disks.

CreateCapacityReservation.title: Create a capacity reservation
CreateCapacityReservation.summary: Creates a capacity reservation by specifying the instance type, total quantity, effective mode, and zone.

CreateCommand.title: Creates a Cloud Assistant command.
CreateCommand.summary: Creates a Cloud Assistant command of the Shell, PowerShell, or Bat script type.

CreateDeploymentSet.title: Create a deployment set in a specified region
CreateDeploymentSet.summary: Creates a deployment set in a specified region.

CreateDiagnosticMetricSet.title: Create a resource diagnostic metric set
CreateDiagnosticMetricSet.summary: Creates a diagnostic metric set for resources. You can flexibly combine diagnostic metrics as needed.

CreateDiagnosticReport.title: Create a resource diagnostic report
CreateDiagnosticReport.summary: Creates a resource diagnostic report. Based on the diagnostic metric set ID that you specify, a diagnostic report is generated for multiple diagnostic metrics. You can call DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes with the returned diagnostic report ID to query the details of the resource diagnostic report.

CreateDisk.title: Create a data disk
CreateDisk.summary: Creates a pay-as-you-go or subscription data disk.

CreateElasticityAssurance.title: Creates an elasticity assurance.
CreateElasticityAssurance.summary: Creates an elasticity assurance service by specifying parameters such as the zone, instance type, purchase duration, and auto-renewal settings within the region of the elasticity assurance service.

CreateHaVip.title: CreateHaVip
CreateHaVip.summary: Creates a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip).

CreateImage.title: Create a custom image
CreateImage.summary: Creates a custom image. You can use the created custom image to create ECS instances (RunInstances) or replace the system disk of an instance (ReplaceSystemDisk).

CreateImageComponent.title: Create an image component
CreateImageComponent.summary: Creates an image component. Image components are used to store commonly used build template commands for image building.

CreateImagePipeline.title: Create an image build template
CreateImagePipeline.summary: Creates an image template. Image templates can be used to build images.

CreateInstance.title: Creates an instance.
CreateInstance.summary: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. You can use this operation to flexibly configure various parameters based on your requirements to create a customized instance.

CreateKeyPair.title: Create a key pair
CreateKeyPair.summary: Calls CreateKeyPair to create an SSH key pair. The system stores the public key and returns the private key in unencrypted PEM-encoded PKCS#8 format. You must securely store the private key on your own.

CreateLaunchTemplate.title: Create a launch template
CreateLaunchTemplate.summary: Creates an ECS instance launch template. A launch template eliminates the need to configure a large number of parameters every time you create an instance.

CreateLaunchTemplateVersion.title: Create a new version of a launch template
CreateLaunchTemplateVersion.summary: Creates a new version of a specified ECS launch template for subsequent creation of ECS instances, elastic scaling groups, or auto provisioning groups.

CreateNetworkInterface.title: Create an ENI
CreateNetworkInterface.summary: Creates an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) with support for specifying a primary private IP address.

CreateNetworkInterfacePermission.title: Grant NIC permissions to a certified ISV or individual user
CreateNetworkInterfacePermission.summary: Grants Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user.

CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow.title: Create an O&M window
CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow.summary: Creates an O&M window. When the TargetResource parameter of the O&M window is set to associate with ECS instances and a hardware risk is detected at the underlying layer that requires scheduled O&M to mitigate, the execution time of the scheduled O&M is determined based on the time range specified by the TimePeriod parameter. When the execution time of the O&M event is reached, the platform automatically performs the corresponding O&M operation based on the event type.

CreatePortRangeList.title: Create a port list
CreatePortRangeList.summary: Creates a port list that can be associated with resources such as security groups.

CreateSimulatedSystemEvents.title: Schedule simulated system events for instances
CreateSimulatedSystemEvents.summary: Schedules simulated system events for one or more ECS instances. Simulated system events serve as event drills and do not actually execute events or affect ECS instances.

CreateSnapshot.title: Create a snapshot
CreateSnapshot.summary: Creates a snapshot for a disk.

CreateSnapshotGroup.title: Create a snapshot-consistent group
CreateSnapshotGroup.summary: Creates a snapshot-consistent group for disks in a specified ECS instance. A snapshot-consistent group contains snapshots of one or more disks.

CreateVsc.title: Create a virtual storage channel (VSC)
CreateVsc.summary: Creates a Virtual Storage Channel (VSC) for an ECS instance.

DeleteAutoProvisioningGroup.title: Delete an auto provisioning group
DeleteAutoProvisioningGroup.summary: Deletes an auto provisioning group by specifying the AutoProvisioningGroupId and TerminateInstances parameters.

DeleteAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: Delete an automatic snapshot policy
DeleteAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Deletes an automatic snapshot policy. If the target automatic snapshot policy has been applied to cloud disks, the cloud disks no longer execute the policy after it is deleted.

DeleteCommand.title: Delete a Cloud assistant command
DeleteCommand.summary: Deletes a Cloud Assistant command. You cannot delete a command that is being executed.

DeleteDedicatedHostCluster.title: Delete a dedicated host cluster
DeleteDedicatedHostCluster.summary: Deletes a dedicated host cluster. Before you perform this operation, migrate the dedicated hosts in the dedicated host cluster to another dedicated host cluster.

DeleteDiagnosticMetricSets.title: Delete diagnostic metric sets
DeleteDiagnosticMetricSets.summary: Deletes diagnostic metric sets for resources.

DeleteDisk.title: Release a pay-as-you-go data disk
DeleteDisk.summary: Releases a pay-as-you-go data disk. Disk types include basic disks, ultra disks, standard SSDs, and enterprise SSDs.

DeleteImage.title: Delete a custom image
DeleteImage.summary: Deletes a custom image. You can specify the ImageId and Force parameters.

DeleteImageComponent.title: Delete an image component
DeleteImageComponent.summary: Deletes an image component by specifying the RegionId and ImageComponentId parameters.

DeleteInstance.title: Delete an instance
DeleteInstance.summary: Deletes or releases a specified ECS instance.

DeleteInstances.title: Release instances in a batch
DeleteInstances.summary: Releases multiple pay-as-you-go instances or expired subscription instances in a batch. You can specify whether to release or convert associated disks to pay-as-you-go disks.

DeleteKeyPairs.title: Batch delete key pairs
DeleteKeyPairs.summary: Deletes one or more SSH key pairs.

DeleteLaunchTemplate.title: Delete a launch template
DeleteLaunchTemplate.summary: Deletes a launch template in a specified region by specifying the LaunchTemplateId or LaunchTemplateName parameter.

DeleteLaunchTemplateVersion.title: Delete launch template versions
DeleteLaunchTemplateVersion.summary: Deletes one or more versions of a specified launch template by specifying parameters such as LaunchTemplateId and DeleteVersion.

DeleteNetworkInterface.title: Delete an ENI
DeleteNetworkInterface.summary: Asynchronously deletes an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission.title: DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission.summary: Deletes the permission to operate an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

DeletePortRangeList.title: Delete a port list
DeletePortRangeList.summary: Deletes a specified port list. All port list entries in the port list are also deleted.

DeletePrefixList.title: Delete a prefix list
DeletePrefixList.summary: Deletes a specified prefix list and all entries in the prefix list.

DeleteSecurityGroup.title: Delete a security group
DeleteSecurityGroup.summary: Deletes a security group and all security group rules within it.

DeleteSnapshot.title: Deletes a snapshot.
DeleteSnapshot.summary: Deletes a specified snapshot. You can also call this operation to cancel a snapshot that is being created.

DeregisterManagedInstance.title: Unregister a managed instance
DeregisterManagedInstance.summary: Calls DeregisterManagedInstance to unregister a managed instance. After the instance is unregistered, you can no longer use Cloud Assistant to send commands or files to the instance.

DescribeAccountAttributes.title: Query resource quotas
DescribeAccountAttributes.summary: Queries the resource quotas that you can create in an Alibaba Cloud region. The quotas include the maximum numbers of security groups, Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs), pay-as-you-go instance vCPUs, spot instance vCPUs, pay-as-you-go cloud disk capacity, dedicated hosts, network interface controllers (NICs), network types, and whether the account has completed real-name registration.

DescribeActivations.title: Query activation code usage
DescribeActivations.summary: Queries the activation codes that you have created and the usage of the activation codes.

DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory.title: Query scheduling node information of an auto provisioning group
DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory.summary: Invokes DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory to query the scheduling node information of an auto provisioning group.

DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupInstances.title: Query instances in an auto-provisioning group
DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupInstances.summary: Queries the instances in an auto-provisioning group.

DescribeAutoProvisioningGroups.title: Query auto-provisioning groups
DescribeAutoProvisioningGroups.summary: Queries one or more auto-provisioning groups.

DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations.title: Query automatic snapshot policy associations
DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyAssociations.summary: Queries the associate relationships of an automatic snapshot policy.

DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.title: Query automatic snapshot policies
DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.summary: Queries the details of automatic snapshot policies that are created in a specified region.

DescribeAvailableResource.title: Query resource inventory in a zone
DescribeAvailableResource.summary: Queries the inventory status of resources in a specified zone. This operation is primarily used to check whether target resources (such as instance types and system disk types) are sufficiently stocked in a specific zone before you create instances (RunInstances) or modify instance specifications (ModifyInstanceSpec).

DescribeBandwidthLimitation.title: Query public bandwidth limits for different instance types
DescribeBandwidthLimitation.summary: Queries the maximum public bandwidth that can be purchased, upgraded, or downgraded for different instance types.

DescribeCapacityReservationInstances.title: Query instances matched by a capacity reservation
DescribeCapacityReservationInstances.summary: Queries the list of instances that match a capacity reservation.

DescribeCapacityReservations.title: Query capacity reservation information
DescribeCapacityReservations.summary: Queries the details of one or more capacity reservations, such as the status, effective and expiration time, private pool mode, and number of used instances.

DescribeClassicLinkInstances.title: Query classic network type instances connected to a VPC
DescribeClassicLinkInstances.summary: Queries one or more classic network type instances that are connected to a virtual private cloud (VPC).

DescribeCloudAssistantStatus.title: Query Cloud assistant installation status
DescribeCloudAssistantStatus.summary: Queries whether Cloud Assistant Agent is installed on one or more instances. If Cloud Assistant is installed, the response also includes the total number of command executions, the number of ongoing executions, and the time of the most recent command execution.

DescribeCommands.title: Query created Cloud assistant commands
DescribeCommands.summary: Queries Cloud Assistant commands that you manually created or public commands provided by Alibaba Cloud.

DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew.title: Query auto-renewal status of dedicated hosts
DescribeDedicatedHostAutoRenew.summary: Queries the auto-renewal status of one or more subscription dedicated hosts.

DescribeDedicatedHostClusters.title: Query dedicated host cluster details
DescribeDedicatedHostClusters.summary: Queries the details of one or more dedicated host clusters.

DescribeDedicatedHostTypes.title: Query dedicated host type details
DescribeDedicatedHostTypes.summary: Invokes DescribeDedicatedHostTypes to query the detailed parameters of dedicated host types supported in a specified region, or queries the ECS instance families supported by dedicated hosts.

DescribeDedicatedHosts.title: Query dedicated host details
DescribeDedicatedHosts.summary: Queries the details of one or more dedicated hosts. You can retrieve information such as the physical performance metrics, machine ID, usage status, and the list of ECS instances created on the dedicated hosts. You can filter results by specifying parameters such as dedicated host IDs, dedicated host cluster ID, hostname, and status to precisely query the details you need, providing support for efficient management and optimization of cloud computing compute resources.

DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTy.title: Query instance families that support deployment sets
DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTy.summary: Calls DescribeDeploymentSetSupportedInstanceTypeFamily to query the instance families that support each deployment set strategy by specifying the RegionId and Strategy parameters.

DescribeDeploymentSets.title: Query deployment set attributes
DescribeDeploymentSets.summary: Queries the details of one or more deployment sets.

DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets.title: Query resource diagnostic metric sets
DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets.summary: Queries the list of resource diagnostic metric sets by calling DescribeDiagnosticMetricSets.

DescribeDiagnosticMetrics.title: Query diagnostic metrics
DescribeDiagnosticMetrics.summary: Queries a list of diagnostic metrics.

DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes.title: Query resource diagnostic report details
DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes.summary: Queries the details of a resource diagnostic report.

DescribeDiagnosticReports.title: Query resource diagnostic reports
DescribeDiagnosticReports.summary: Queries a list of resource diagnostic reports.

DescribeDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.title: Query the key used for account-level default encryption of block storage
DescribeDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.summary: Queries the key used for account-level default encryption of block storage.

DescribeDiskEncryptionByDefaultStatus.title: Query the service status of account-level default encryption for block storage
DescribeDiskEncryptionByDefaultStatus.summary: Queries the service status of account-level default encryption for block storage in a specified region.

DescribeDiskMonitorData.title: Query cloud disk monitoring data
DescribeDiskMonitorData.summary: Queries the usage information of a cloud disk within a specified time period, such as read IOPS, write IOPS, read bandwidth (B/s), write bandwidth (B/s), read latency (μs), and write latency (μs).

DescribeDisks.title: Query block storage
DescribeDisks.summary: Queries information about one or more created block storage devices, including disks, local disks, and elastic ephemeral disks.

DescribeDisksFullStatus.title: Query the full status information of block storage devices
DescribeDisksFullStatus.summary: Queries the full status information of one or more block storage devices.

DescribeElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttr.title: Query auto-renewal of elasticity assurance services
DescribeElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttr.summary: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more elasticity assurance services.

DescribeElasticityAssuranceInstances.title: Query instances matched to an elasticity assurance
DescribeElasticityAssuranceInstances.summary: Queries the list of running instances that are matched to an elasticity assurance.

DescribeElasticityAssurances.title: Query elasticity assurance service information
DescribeElasticityAssurances.summary: Queries the details of an elasticity assurance service, such as the status, matching mode, effective method, expiration time, and number of used instances.

DescribeEniMonitorData.title: Query secondary ENI monitoring data
DescribeEniMonitorData.summary: Queries the traffic information of a secondary ENI within a specified time period.

DescribeForwardTableEntries.title: DescribeForwardTableEntries
DescribeForwardTableEntries.summary: Queries DNAT entries in a DNAT table.

DescribeHaVips.title: DescribeHaVips
DescribeHaVips.summary: Queries the details of high-availability virtual IP addresses (HAVIPs).

DescribeHpcClusters.title: Query HPC clusters
DescribeHpcClusters.summary: Queries available HPC clusters. The request parameters are used as filters. The filters are evaluated by using a logical AND. The parameters are independent of each other.

DescribeImageComponents.title: Query image component details
DescribeImageComponents.summary: Queries the details of one or more image components.

DescribeImageFromFamily.title: Query available images in an image family
DescribeImageFromFamily.summary: Queries the latest available custom image in a specified image family.

DescribeImagePipelineExecutions.title: Query details of an image build task
DescribeImagePipelineExecutions.summary: Queries the details of an image build task.

DescribeImagePipelines.title: Query image template details
DescribeImagePipelines.summary: Queries the details of one or more image templates.

DescribeImageSharePermission.title: Query all users with whom a custom image is shared
DescribeImageSharePermission.summary: Queries all users with whom a custom image has been shared. The results are displayed by page, with 10 entries per page by default.

DescribeImageSupportInstanceTypes.title: Query instance types supported by a specified image
DescribeImageSupportInstanceTypes.summary: Queries the instance types supported by a specified image.

DescribeImages.title: Query image resources
DescribeImages.summary: Queries the list of available image resources based on specified parameters such as ImageId, image usage Scenarios, and Filter conditions.

DescribeInstanceAttachmentAttributes.title: Query private pool information matched by instances
DescribeInstanceAttachmentAttributes.summary: Queries the private pool information matched by instances, such as the matching mode and private pool ID.

DescribeInstanceAttribute.title: Query instance attribute information
DescribeInstanceAttribute.summary: Queries the attribute information of a specified ECS instance.

DescribeInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.title: Query auto-renewal attributes of instances
DescribeInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.summary: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more subscription ECS instances, including whether auto-renewal is enabled and the renewal period.

DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents.title: Query system events of a specified instance
DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents.summary: Queries the system event information of a specified instance by calling the DescribeInstanceHistoryEvents operation. You can specify parameters such as InstanceId and EventType. By default, this operation queries historical system events in inactive states.

DescribeInstanceMaintenanceAttributes.title: Query maintenance attributes of an instance
DescribeInstanceMaintenanceAttributes.summary: Queries the maintenance attributes of an instance.

DescribeInstanceModificationPrice.title: Query upgrade prices for unexpired subscription ECS instances
DescribeInstanceModificationPrice.summary: Queries the price of upgrading the target instance type or adding subscription data disks for an unexpired subscription ECS instance.

DescribeInstanceMonitorData.title: Query instance monitoring data
DescribeInstanceMonitorData.summary: Queries the monitoring information of an ECS instance. Queryable metrics include vCPU usage, burstable instance credits, inbound data traffic, outbound data traffic, and average bandwidth.

DescribeInstanceRamRole.title: Queries the RAM roles assigned to an instance.
DescribeInstanceRamRole.summary: Queries the instance RAM roles that are assigned to one or more ECS instances by instance ID, or queries the instances that are assigned a specific instance RAM role by role name.

DescribeInstanceStatus.title: Query instance status information
DescribeInstanceStatus.summary: Queries the status information of one or more specified ECS instances and supports querying instance lists based on specified conditions.

DescribeInstanceTypeFamilies.title: Query instance families
DescribeInstanceTypeFamilies.summary: Queries the list of instance families provided by Alibaba Cloud ECS. This operation retrieves instance family information across different series to help you understand available instance type resources and select appropriate instance types for creating ECS instances.

DescribeInstanceTypes.title: Query instance type information
DescribeInstanceTypes.summary: Queries the information list of all instance types provided by Elastic Compute Service (ECS) and retrieves detailed information about instance types. You can also perform a conditional query for specific instance types to understand the configurations and performance of different instance types and select instances that meet your business requirements.

DescribeInstanceVncUrl.title: Query the VNC logon URL of an instance
DescribeInstanceVncUrl.summary: Queries the VNC logon URL of an ECS instance.

DescribeInstances.title: Query detailed information of instances
DescribeInstances.summary: Queries a list of instances based on specified conditional query conditions and associates the detailed information of the instances.

DescribeInstancesFullStatus.title: Query full status information of instances
DescribeInstancesFullStatus.summary: Queries the full status information of one or more ECS instances. The full status information includes the instance status and instance system event status. The instance status refers to the lifecycle status of the instance, and the instance system event refers to the health status of maintenance events.

DescribeInvocationResults.title: Query Cloud assistant command execution results
DescribeInvocationResults.summary: Queries the execution results of one or more Cloud Assistant commands, specifically the actual execution results on ECS instances.

DescribeInvocations.title: Query Cloud assistant command execution information
DescribeInvocations.summary: Queries the execution list and status of Cloud Assistant commands.

DescribeKeyPairs.title: Query key pairs
DescribeKeyPairs.summary: Queries one or more SSH key pairs.

DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions.title: Query launch template version information
DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions.summary: Queries information about launch template versions of ECS instances, such as the total number of instance launch templates, template names, and template version numbers.

DescribeLaunchTemplates.title: Query one or more available launch templates
DescribeLaunchTemplates.summary: Calls the DescribeLaunchTemplates operation to query information about one or more launch templates. You can specify parameters such as TemplateTag, TemplateResourceGroupId, and LaunchTemplateId. The returned information includes the total number of launch templates, template creation time, and latest template version number.

DescribeLockedSnapshots.title: Query snapshot lock information
DescribeLockedSnapshots.summary: Queries the lock information of snapshots, such as the lock status and lock configurations.

DescribeManagedInstances.title: Retrieve managed instances
DescribeManagedInstances.summary: Queries the list of managed instances.

DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute.title: Query ENI attributes
DescribeNetworkInterfaceAttribute.summary: Queries the details of an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) by specifying the ENI ID.

DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions.title: Query ENI permissions granted to certified ISVs or individual users
DescribeNetworkInterfacePermissions.summary: Queries the list of Elastic Network Interface (ENI) permissions that you have granted to an Alibaba Cloud partner (certified ISV) or an individual user.

DescribeNetworkInterfaces.title: List ENIs
DescribeNetworkInterfaces.summary: Queries the details of one or more Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs).

DescribeNewProjectEipMonitorData.title: DescribeNewProjectEipMonitorData
DescribeNewProjectEipMonitorData.summary: Queries the monitoring data of an Elastic IP Address (EIP) in the new BGP (Multi-ISP) network.

DescribePortRangeListAssociations.title: Queries the resources associated with a port list.
DescribePortRangeListAssociations.summary: Queries the resources associated with a specified port range list, such as security groups.

DescribePortRangeListEntries.title: Query entries of a port range list
DescribePortRangeListEntries.summary: Queries the entries of a specified port range list.

DescribePortRangeLists.title: Query port range lists
DescribePortRangeLists.summary: Queries a list of port range lists.

DescribePrefixListAssociations.title: Query resources associated with a prefix list
DescribePrefixListAssociations.summary: Queries the information about resources associated with a specified prefix list, such as resource IDs and resource types.

DescribePrefixListAttributes.title: Query details of a prefix list
DescribePrefixListAttributes.summary: Queries the details of a specified prefix list, including the name, address family, maximum number of entries, and entry details.

DescribePrefixLists.title: Query prefix lists
DescribePrefixLists.summary: Queries the information about one or more prefix lists.

DescribePrice.title: Query price
DescribePrice.summary: Queries the latest prices of specified resources. You can query the latest prices of ECS instances, disks, dedicated hosts, elasticity assurance services, and capacity reservation services based on resource type. The response includes promotion rules, prices, and discounts.

DescribeRecommendInstanceType.title: Find alternative instance types
DescribeRecommendInstanceType.summary: (Beta) Queries one or more alternative instance types based on a specified instance type. For retired or soon-to-be-retired instance types, DescribeRecommendInstanceType lists all instance types that can serve as replacements.

DescribeRegions.title: Query regions
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries a list of regions based on parameters such as billing method and resource type.

DescribeRenewalPrice.title: Query resource renewal price
DescribeRenewalPrice.summary: Queries the renewal price of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) resources. Only subscription resources are supported.

DescribeReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribu.title: Query auto-renewal attributes of reserved instances
DescribeReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribu.summary: Queries the auto-renewal attributes of one or more reserved instances, including the auto-renewal duration and auto-renewal status.

DescribeReservedInstances.title: Query reserved instance details
DescribeReservedInstances.summary: Queries the list of reserved instances that you have purchased in a specified region. You can filter reserved instances by tags, reserved instance attributes, and other parameters.

DescribeResourceByTags.title: Retrieve resources by tag
DescribeResourceByTags.summary: Retrieves resources based on tags. You can retrieve resources by tag or by resource type.

DescribeResourcesModification.title: Query resource inventory before changing instance type or system disk type
DescribeResourcesModification.summary: Queries the inventory of instance types or system disk types in a zone before you change the instance type or system disk type of an instance.

DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute.title: Query a security group and its rules
DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute.summary: Queries the details of a specified security group, including the list of security group rules.

DescribeSecurityGroupReferences.title: Query authorized security group list
DescribeSecurityGroupReferences.summary: Queries the list of other security groups that have been authorized by one or more specified security groups.

DescribeSecurityGroups.title: Query basic information about security groups
DescribeSecurityGroups.summary: Queries the basic information about security groups. You can filter results by region, security group ID, security group type, and other parameter query conditions.

DescribeSendFileResults.title: Query Cloud assistant file sending list and status
DescribeSendFileResults.summary: Queries the list and status of files sent by Cloud Assistant.

DescribeSnapshotGroups.title: Query snapshot-consistent groups
DescribeSnapshotGroups.summary: Queries information about one or more snapshot-consistent groups, such as the status, instance ID, and snapshot creation progress.

DescribeSnapshotLinks.title: Query disk snapshot chains
DescribeSnapshotLinks.summary: Queries snapshot chains of disks. A snapshot chain consists of all snapshots of a disk. Each disk corresponds to one snapshot chain.

DescribeSnapshotMonitorData.title: Query snapshot size change monitoring data within the last 30 days
DescribeSnapshotMonitorData.summary: Queries the monitoring data of snapshot size changes within the last 30 days in a region.

DescribeSnapshotPackage.title: Query purchased OSS storage plans in a region
DescribeSnapshotPackage.summary: Queries the Object Storage Service (OSS) storage plans that you have purchased in a region. Storage plans can be used to offset the storage capacity of standard snapshots but do not support offsetting local snapshots.

DescribeSnapshots.title: Query disk snapshot list
DescribeSnapshots.summary: Queries the snapshot list of a disk, including snapshot status, remaining time for a snapshot being created, and automatic snapshot retention days.

DescribeSnapshotsUsage.title: Query snapshot count and size
DescribeSnapshotsUsage.summary: Queries the number of snapshots and the total snapshot size in a region.

DescribeSpotAdvice.title: Query average release rate and discount rate of spot instances
DescribeSpotAdvice.summary: Queries the average release rate, average discount rate, and other information about spot instances in a specified region over the last 30 days.

DescribeSpotPriceHistory.title: Query historical prices of spot instances
DescribeSpotPriceHistory.summary: Queries the historical prices of spot instances. You can query price data for up to the last 30 days. The historical price data helps you set a reasonable maximum price for a spot instance.

DescribeStorageCapacityUnits.title: Query storage capacity unit details
DescribeStorageCapacityUnits.summary: Queries the detailed information list of storage capacity units (SCUs). You can filter results by name, status, and capacity.

DescribeTags.title: Queries available tags.
DescribeTags.summary: Queries tags available to you. You can perform a conditional query for tags by resource type, resource ID, tag key, or tag value. The filter conditions are evaluated by using a logical AND (&&) operator, and only tags that match all filter conditions are returned.

DescribeTaskAttribute.title: Query task details
DescribeTaskAttribute.summary: Queries the details of an asynchronous task. Currently, you can query the following asynchronous tasks: ImportImage, ExportImage, and ModifyDiskSpec.

DescribeTasks.title: Query tasks
DescribeTasks.summary: Queries the progress of one or more asynchronous requests.

DescribeTerminalSessions.title: View session manager session history
DescribeTerminalSessions.summary: Queries the session history of Session Manager.

DescribeUserBusinessBehavior.title: DescribeUserBusinessBehavior
DescribeUserBusinessBehavior.summary: Retrieves the default attributes at the user level.

DescribeUserData.title: Query instance user data
DescribeUserData.summary: Queries the user data of an ECS instance.

DescribeVRouters.title: Query the list of routers in a specified region

DescribeVscs.title: Query virtual storage channels (VSCs) in batch
DescribeVscs.summary: Queries virtual storage channels (VSCs). You can filter results by VscId, instance, status, or tags.

DescribeZones.title: Query zones
DescribeZones.summary: Queries the list of zones based on parameter query conditions such as region ID and billing method.

DetachClassicLinkVpc.title: Disconnect a classic network-type instance from a VPC
DetachClassicLinkVpc.summary: Invokes DetachClassicLinkVpc to disconnect a classic network type ECS instance from a virtual private cloud (VPC) by removing the ClassicLink connection. After the ClassicLink connection is removed, the classic network type instance cannot communicate with instances in the VPC.

DetachDisk.title: Detach a pay-as-you-go data disk or system disk
DetachDisk.summary: Detaches a pay-as-you-go data disk or system disk from an ECS instance.

DetachInstanceRamRole.title: Detach instance RAM roles from instances
DetachInstanceRamRole.summary: Detaches instance RAM roles from one or more ECS instances.

DetachKeyPair.title: Unbind SSH key pairs from linux instances
DetachKeyPair.summary: Unbinds SSH key pairs from one or more Linux instances.

DetachNetworkInterface.title: Detach an ENI from an instance
DetachNetworkInterface.summary: Detaches an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) from an ECS instance.

DisableActivation.title: Manually disables a specified activation code

DisableDiskEncryptionByDefault.title: Disable account-level default encryption for block storage
DisableDiskEncryptionByDefault.summary: Disables account-level default encryption for block storage in a specified region.

DisableNetworkInterfaceQoS.title: Disable ENI QoS rate limiting settings
DisableNetworkInterfaceQoS.summary: Disables the QoS rate limiting settings for an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

EnableDiskEncryptionByDefault.title: Enable account-level default encryption for block storage
EnableDiskEncryptionByDefault.summary: Enables account-level default encryption for block storage in a specified region.

EnableNetworkInterfaceQoS.title: Enable or modify ENI QoS rate limiting settings
EnableNetworkInterfaceQoS.summary: Enables or modifies the QoS rate limiting settings of an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

EndTerminalSession.title: Close a terminal session
EndTerminalSession.summary: Permanently closes the data connection of a specified session.

ExportImage.title: Export a custom image to OSS
ExportImage.summary: Exports a custom image to an OSS bucket in the same region as the custom image.

ExportSnapshot.title: ExportSnapshot
ExportSnapshot.summary: Exports a snapshot to a specified object storage ddasd.

GetInstanceConsoleOutput.title: Retrieve instance system command line output
GetInstanceConsoleOutput.summary: Retrieves the system command line output of an instance. The data is returned in Base64-encoded format.

GetInstanceScreenshot.title: Retrieve instance screenshot information
GetInstanceScreenshot.summary: Retrieves the screenshot information of an instance.

ImportImage.title: Import a local image file
ImportImage.summary: Imports a local image file to Elastic Compute Service (ECS) as a custom image that appears in the specified region. You can then use the imported image to create ECS instances (RunInstances) or replace the system disk of an instance (ReplaceSystemDisk).

ImportKeyPair.title: Import the public key of a key pair
ImportKeyPair.summary: Imports the public key of an RSA key pair generated by another tool. After you import the key pair, Alibaba Cloud stores the public key. You must store the private key on your own.

InstallCloudAssistant.title: Install Cloud assistant agent on instances
InstallCloudAssistant.summary: Installs Cloud Assistant Agent on one or more ECS instances. You must restart the instances to complete the installation.

InvokeCommand.title: Run a Cloud assistant command
InvokeCommand.summary: Triggers a Cloud Assistant command on one or more ECS instances by specifying parameters such as CommandId, InstanceId, and ResourceGroupId.

JoinResourceGroup.title: Add an ECS resource or service to a resource group
JoinResourceGroup.summary: Adds an ECS resource or service to a resource group.

JoinSecurityGroup.title: Join a security group
JoinSecurityGroup.summary: Adds an ECS instance or an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) to a specified security group.

LeaveSecurityGroup.title: Remove from a security group
LeaveSecurityGroup.summary: Removes an ECS instance or an Elastic Network Interface (ENI) from a specified security group.

ListPluginStatus.title: Query the status of Cloud assistant plugins on instances
ListPluginStatus.summary: Queries the status of Cloud Assistant plugins on instances.

ListTagResources.title: Query tags bound to resources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the tags that are bound to one or more ECS resources.

LockSnapshot.title: Locks a snapshot
LockSnapshot.summary: Locks a snapshot in compliance mode to prevent the snapshot from being accidentally or maliciously deleted. During the lock period, no user can delete the snapshot.

ModifyAutoProvisioningGroup.title: Modify the configurations of an auto provisioning group
ModifyAutoProvisioningGroup.summary: Modifies the configurations of an auto provisioning group.

ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.title: Modify an automatic snapshot policy
ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicyEx.summary: Modifies an automatic snapshot policy, such as the snapshot creation time, repeat days, and retention period.

ModifyBandwidthPackageSpec.title: ModifyBandwidthPackageSpec
ModifyBandwidthPackageSpec.summary: Modifies the bandwidth of a bandwidth package.

ModifyCapacityReservation.title: Modify partial information of a capacity reservation
ModifyCapacityReservation.summary: Modifies partial information of a capacity reservation, including the name, description, expiration method, and total number of reserved instances.

ModifyCloudAssistantSettings.title: Modify Cloud assistant service configurations
ModifyCloudAssistantSettings.summary: Modifies the Cloud Assistant service configurations.

ModifyCommand.title: Modifies a Cloud assistant command
ModifyCommand.summary: Modifies the parameters of a Cloud Assistant command.

ModifyDedicatedHostAttribute.title: Modifies the information of a dedicated host.
ModifyDedicatedHostAttribute.summary: Modifies the information about a dedicated host, such as the name, description, and service availability attributes.

ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime.title: Set the automatic release time for a dedicated host
ModifyDedicatedHostAutoReleaseTime.summary: Sets or cancels the automatic release time for a pay-as-you-go dedicated host.

ModifyDedicatedHostAutoRenewAttribute.title: Set or cancel auto-renewal for dedicated hosts
ModifyDedicatedHostAutoRenewAttribute.summary: Configures auto-renewal for one or more subscription dedicated hosts, or cancels the auto-renewal that has been configured.

ModifyDedicatedHostClusterAttribute.title: Modify dedicated host cluster information
ModifyDedicatedHostClusterAttribute.summary: Modifies some information about a dedicated host cluster, including the name, description, and properties of the dedicated host cluster.

ModifyDedicatedHostsChargeType.title: Modify the billing method of dedicated hosts
ModifyDedicatedHostsChargeType.summary: Modifies the billing method of dedicated hosts.

ModifyDeploymentSetAttribute.title: Modify the name and description of a deployment set
ModifyDeploymentSetAttribute.summary: Modifies the name and description of a deployment set.

ModifyDiagnosticMetricSet.title: Modify a resource diagnostic metric set
ModifyDiagnosticMetricSet.summary: Modifies a resource diagnostic metric set.

ModifyDiskAttribute.title: Modify block storage attributes
ModifyDiskAttribute.summary: Modifies the name, description, release behavior, automatic snapshot deletion policy, automatic snapshot policy, performance burst settings, and other attributes of one or more block storage devices.

ModifyDiskChargeType.title: Change the billing method of a cloud disk
ModifyDiskChargeType.summary: Converts the billing method of data disks attached to a subscription ECS instance between pay-as-you-go and subscription.

ModifyDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.title: Modify the key used for block storage account-level default encryption
ModifyDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.summary: Modifies the KMS key ID used for block storage account-level default encryption in a specified region.

ModifyDiskDeployment.title: Migrate a disk
ModifyDiskDeployment.summary: Migrates a disk into or out of a dedicated block storage cluster, or migrates a disk between dedicated block storage clusters.

ModifyDiskSpec.title: Change disk type or performance level
ModifyDiskSpec.summary: Changes the type of a disk or modifies the performance level (PL) of an enterprise SSD (ESSD). Regional Enterprise SSD (ESSD), basic disks, elastic ephemeral disks, and local disks do not support disk type changes.

ModifyElasticityAssurance.title: Modify elasticity assurance information
ModifyElasticityAssurance.summary: Modifies some information about an elasticity assurance, including its name, description, and capacity (only capacity reduction is supported).

ModifyElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttrib.title: Modify auto-renewal of elasticity assurance services
ModifyElasticityAssuranceAutoRenewAttrib.summary: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more elasticity assurance services.

ModifyForwardEntry.title: ModifyForwardEntry
ModifyForwardEntry.summary: Modifies the properties of a specified forward entry.

ModifyHaVipAttribute.title: ModifyHaVipAttribute
ModifyHaVipAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of a specified HAVIP instance.

ModifyHpcClusterAttribute.title: Modify the description of an HPC cluster
ModifyHpcClusterAttribute.summary: Modifies the description of an HPC cluster.

ModifyImageAttribute.title: Modify custom image attributes
ModifyImageAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of a custom image, such as the image family, name, boot mode, status, and NVMe support, by calling the ModifyImageAttribute operation with parameters such as ImageId and ImageFamily.

ModifyImageShareGroupPermission.title: ModifyImageShareGroupPermission
ModifyImageShareGroupPermission.summary: Modifies the permissions of an image share group.

ModifyImageSharePermission.title: Manage image sharing permissions
ModifyImageSharePermission.summary: Manages image sharing permissions. You can share your custom images with other Alibaba Cloud accounts or publish them as community images for others to use.

ModifyInstanceAttachmentAttributes.title: Modify private pool attributes of an instance
ModifyInstanceAttachmentAttributes.summary: Modifies the private pool matching mode of an instance.

ModifyInstanceAttribute.title: Modify instance attributes
ModifyInstanceAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of an ECS instance, including the password, instance name, hostname, security groups, MTU, and instance user data.

ModifyInstanceAutoReleaseTime.title: Modify the automatic release time of an instance
ModifyInstanceAutoReleaseTime.summary: Modifies the automatic release time of a specified pay-as-you-go or spot instance, and supports canceling the automatic release feature.

ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.title: Modify the auto-renewal attributes of instances
ModifyInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.summary: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more subscription instances to help reduce the maintenance costs of expiring resources.

ModifyInstanceChargeType.title: Modify instance billing method
ModifyInstanceChargeType.summary: Modifies the billing method of ECS instances. Batch modification is supported.

ModifyInstanceClockOptions.title: Modify instance clock options
ModifyInstanceClockOptions.summary: Modifies the clock options of an instance as needed.

ModifyInstanceDeployment.title: ModifyInstanceDeployment
ModifyInstanceDeployment.summary: Changes the deployment set of an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance or migrates an ECS instance to a dedicated host. You can change the instance type of an ECS instance when you migrate the instance.

ModifyInstanceMaintenanceAttributes.title: Modify the maintenance attributes of an instance
ModifyInstanceMaintenanceAttributes.summary: Modifies the maintenance attributes of an instance.

ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions.title: Modify instance metadata access settings
ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions.summary: Modifies the metadata access settings for an instance in a specified region, including whether to enable the metadata access channel and whether to enable the security hardening mode for metadata access.

ModifyInstanceNetworkOptions.title: Modify instance network options
ModifyInstanceNetworkOptions.summary: Modifies the network options of an instance.

ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec.title: Modify ECS instance bandwidth or assign a public IP address
ModifyInstanceNetworkSpec.summary: Modifies the bandwidth configuration of an ECS instance, allocates an Internet IP address, or transforms the network billing method. Both upgrades and downgrades are supported.

ModifyInstanceSpec.title: Modify the instance type or public bandwidth of an instance
ModifyInstanceSpec.summary: Modifies the instance type or public bandwidth of a pay-as-you-go ECS instance.

ModifyInstanceVncPasswd.title: Modify the VNC logon password of an instance
ModifyInstanceVncPasswd.summary: Modifies the VNC logon password of an ECS instance.

ModifyInstanceVpcAttribute.title: Modify VPC attributes of an instance
ModifyInstanceVpcAttribute.summary: Modifies the VPC, private IP address, security group, or vSwitch of a VPC-type ECS instance in a virtual private cloud (VPC) network type.

ModifyInvocationAttribute.title: Modify execution attributes of a Cloud assistant command
ModifyInvocationAttribute.summary: Modifies the execution information of a Cloud Assistant scheduled task, including the command content, scheduled execution method, and adding ECS instances or managed instances to the task.

ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion.title: Switch the default version of a launch template
ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion.summary: Calls the ModifyLaunchTemplateDefaultVersion operation to switch the default version of a launch template by specifying the DefaultVersionNumber parameter. If you do not specify a template version number when you create an instance by calling the RunInstances operation, the default version is used.

ModifyManagedInstance.title: Modify a managed instance
ModifyManagedInstance.summary: Modifies the information of a managed instance.

ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute.title: Modify ENI attributes
ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of an Elastic Network Interface (ENI), such as the queue number, associated security groups, queue depth, communication mode, and whether to retain the ENI when the associated instance is released.

ModifyPhysicalConnectionAttribute.title: ModifyPhysicalConnectionAttribute
ModifyPhysicalConnectionAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of a physical connection.

ModifyPortRangeList.title: Modify port range list attributes
ModifyPortRangeList.summary: Modifies the name and entries of a specified port range list. You can add, modify, and delete entries.

ModifyPrefixList.title: Modify prefix list attributes
ModifyPrefixList.summary: Modifies the name, description, and other attributes of a specified prefix list, and supports adding, modifying, and deleting entries.

ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.title: Modify the instance type of a subscription instance
ModifyPrepayInstanceSpec.summary: Modifies the instance type of a subscription ECS instance. You can upgrade or downgrade the instance type. The modified instance type takes effect for the entire lifecycle of the instance.

ModifyReservedInstanceAttribute.title: Modify reserved instance attributes
ModifyReservedInstanceAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of a reserved instance, including its name and description.

ModifyReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.title: Modify auto-renewal attributes of reserved instances
ModifyReservedInstanceAutoRenewAttribute.summary: Modifies the auto-renewal attributes of one or more reserved instances, allowing you to cancel or disable auto-renewal.

ModifyReservedInstances.title: Modify reserved instance configurations
ModifyReservedInstances.summary: Splits, merges, or changes the scope of reserved instances by modifying configurations such as instance type, quantity, and zone.

ModifyRouterInterfaceAttribute.title: ModifyRouterInterfaceAttribute
ModifyRouterInterfaceAttribute.summary: Modifies the attributes of a router interface.

ModifyRouterInterfaceSpec.title: ModifyRouterInterfaceSpec
ModifyRouterInterfaceSpec.summary: Modifies the specification of a router interface.

ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.title: Modify the name or description of a security group
ModifySecurityGroupAttribute.summary: Modifies the name or description of a specified security group.

ModifySecurityGroupEgressRule.title: Modify an outbound security group rule
ModifySecurityGroupEgressRule.summary: Modifies an outbound security group rule.

ModifySecurityGroupPolicy.title: Modify the intra-group connectivity policy of a basic security group
ModifySecurityGroupPolicy.summary: Modifies the intra-group connectivity policy of a basic security group.

ModifySecurityGroupRule.title: Modify an inbound security group rule
ModifySecurityGroupRule.summary: Modifies an inbound security group rule of a specified security group.

ModifySnapshotAttribute.title: Modify snapshot attributes
ModifySnapshotAttribute.summary: Modifies the name, description, or retention period of a snapshot.

ModifySnapshotCategory.title: Modify snapshot type
ModifySnapshotCategory.summary: Modifies the type of a snapshot. You can call this operation to convert a standard snapshot to an archived snapshot.

ModifySnapshotGroup.title: Modify a snapshot-consistent group
ModifySnapshotGroup.summary: Modifies the name and description of a snapshot-consistent group.

ModifyStorageCapacityUnitAttribute.title: Modify storage capacity unit attributes
ModifyStorageCapacityUnitAttribute.summary: Modifies the name or description of a storage capacity unit (SCU).

ModifySystemEventAttribute.title: Modify scheduled O&M event properties
ModifySystemEventAttribute.summary: Modifies the properties of a scheduled O&M event. Currently, you can modify the planned execute time of a scheduled O&M event.

ModifyVpcAttribute.title: ModifyVpcAttribute
ModifyVpcAttribute.summary: Modifies VPC attributes, such as its name and cidr block.

PurchaseElasticityAssurance.title: Purchase a prepared elastic capacity reservation service
PurchaseElasticityAssurance.summary: Purchases an elastic capacity reservation service. You can use this operation to purchase an elastic capacity reservation service that is prepared and in an inactive state.

PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering.title: Purchase a reserved instance
PurchaseReservedInstancesOffering.summary: Purchases a reserved instance to offset bills of pay-as-you-go instances that match the specified instance type at the regional or zonal level.

PurchaseStorageCapacityUnit.title: Purchase storage capacity units
PurchaseStorageCapacityUnit.summary: Purchases one or more storage capacity units (SCUs).

ReActivateInstances.title: Reactivate an expired or recycled instance
ReActivateInstances.summary: Restarts a pay-as-you-go ECS instance that has expired or been recycled due to an overdue payment.

ReInitDisk.title: Re-initialize a disk to its initial state
ReInitDisk.summary: Re-initializes a disk to its initial state when it was created.

RebootInstances.title: Restarts multiple instances at a time.
RebootInstances.summary: Restarts one or more ECS instances. You can specify whether to force restart instances and set different batch operation modes.

RedeployDedicatedHost.title: Perform fault migration for a dedicated host
RedeployDedicatedHost.summary: Performs fault migration for a dedicated host.

RedeployInstance.title: Redeploy an instance
RedeployInstance.summary: Invokes the RedeployInstance operation to redeploy an ECS instance when the ECS instance receives a system event notification.

ReleaseDedicatedHost.title: Release a dedicated host
ReleaseDedicatedHost.summary: Releases a pay-as-you-go dedicated host or an expired subscription dedicated host.

ReleaseEipAddress.title: ReleaseEipAddress
ReleaseEipAddress.summary: Releases a specified Elastic IP Address (EIP).

ReleasePublicIpAddress.title: ReleasePublicIpAddress
ReleasePublicIpAddress.summary: Releases a public IP from an instance.

RemoveTags.title: Disassociates tags from a resource
RemoveTags.summary: Unbinds one or more tags from resources such as instances, cloud disks, snapshots, images, or security groups.

RenewDedicatedHosts.title: Renew one or more subscription dedicated hosts
RenewDedicatedHosts.summary: Renews one or more subscription dedicated hosts.

RenewElasticityAssurances.title: Renew elasticity assurance services
RenewElasticityAssurances.summary: Renews one or more purchased elasticity assurance services.

RenewInstance.title: Renew an instance
RenewInstance.summary: Renews a subscription Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. You can specify the renewal period or renew the instance to a unified expiration date.

RenewReservedInstances.title: Renew reserved instances
RenewReservedInstances.summary: Renews one or more reserved instances. You can specify the purchase duration and auto-renewal attribute during renewal.

ReplaceSystemDisk.title: Replace the system disk (replace the operating system)
ReplaceSystemDisk.summary: Replaces the operating system of an ECS instance by replacing the system disk. After the replacement, the disk ID of the system disk changes and the original disk is released.

ReportInstancesStatus.title: Report anomalous issues for one or more ECS instances
ReportInstancesStatus.summary: Reports anomalous issues for one or more ECS instances. You can report the same issue that occurs on multiple ECS instances or the same issue that occurs on multiple disks attached to a single ECS instance.

ResetDisk.title: Roll back a cloud disk by using a snapshot
ResetDisk.summary: Rolls back a cloud disk to a previous state by using a cloud disk snapshot.

ResetDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.title: Reset the key used for account-level default encryption of block storage
ResetDiskDefaultKMSKeyId.summary: Resets the KMS key ID used for account-level default encryption of block storage in a specified region to the service key.

ResetDisks.title: Batch reset disks
ResetDisks.summary: Rolls back one or more cloud disks by using an instance snapshot.

ResizeDisk.title: Expand a disk
ResizeDisk.summary: Expands the capacity of a disk, including system disks and data disks.

RevokeSecurityGroup.title: Delete inbound security group rules
RevokeSecurityGroup.summary: Deletes one or more inbound security group rules from a specified security group.

RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.title: Delete outbound security group rules
RevokeSecurityGroupEgress.summary: Deletes one or more outbound security group rules from a specified security group.

RunCommand.title: Create and run a Cloud assistant command
RunCommand.summary: Creates and runs a Cloud Assistant command on one or more ECS instances. This operation supports Shell, PowerShell, and Bat scripts, and provides features such as scheduled execution, custom parameters, and execution within containers on instances.

RunInstances.title: Create instances in a batch
RunInstances.summary: Batch creates ECS instances with support for automatic startup, public IP address allocation, and automatic release time settings.

SendFile.title: Upload a local file to ECS instances
SendFile.summary: Sends a remote file to one or more ECS instances.

StartImagePipelineExecution.title: Runs an image build task by using an image template.
StartImagePipelineExecution.summary: Executes an image building task by using an image template.

StartInstance.title: Start an instance
StartInstance.summary: Starts an ECS instance. You can start an instance by specifying the instance ID and optionally setting parameters such as InitLocalDisk.

StartInstances.title: Start instances in a batch
StartInstances.summary: Starts multiple ECS instances in a batch. You can specify parameters to select different batch operation modes for flexible startup.

StartTerminalSession.title: Start a terminal session
StartTerminalSession.summary: Invokes StartTerminalSession to create a session based on the session management feature. You can establish a WebSocket session with an ECS instance by specifying the instance ID. The WebSocketUrl returned by the operation can be used to establish a remote connection to the ECS instance.

StopInstance.title: Stop an instance
StopInstance.summary: Stops an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance. You can specify the stop method, stop mode, and batch operation mode.

StopInstances.title: Stop instances in batch
StopInstances.summary: Stops one or more ECS instances. You can specify different stop methods, stop modes, and batch operation modes.

StopInvocation.title: Stop a Cloud assistant command
StopInvocation.summary: Stops a running Cloud Assistant command process on one or more ECS instances.

TagResources.title: Create and bind tags
TagResources.summary: Creates and binds tags to specified ECS resources in a single operation.

UnassignIpv6Addresses.title: Unassign IPv6 addresses from an ENI
UnassignIpv6Addresses.summary: Unassigns one or more IPv6 addresses from an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.title: Remove secondary private IP addresses from an ENI
UnassignPrivateIpAddresses.summary: Removes one or more secondary private IP addresses from an Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

UnassociateHaVip.title: UnassociateHaVip
UnassociateHaVip.summary: Disassociates an HaVip from an ECS instance.

UnlockSnapshot.title: Unlock a snapshot
UnlockSnapshot.summary: Unlocks a snapshot that is locked in compliance mode but is still within the cooling-off period. If the snapshot is locked in compliance mode and the cooling-off period has ended, the snapshot cannot be unlocked.

UntagResources.title: Unbind tags from specified resources
UntagResources.summary: Unbinds tags from specified ECS resources. After a tag is unbound, the tag is automatically deleted if it is not bound to any other resources.
